summary: Iteration 6 — validated recall^1.5 short-snippet boost, scroll_routes.py refactor, Sefaria aliyot table, MediaPipe Hand Landmarker offline bundle, and 6-frame OCR voting hook. 67/67 backend pytest tests pass (57 pre-existing + 10 new iteration-6 acceptance) including the previously-failing short-Bereshit margin (now 0.256 > 0.25 threshold) and mangled-OCR Genesis 1:26 (now resolves to col 1-10). The EXACT real-video Tesseract OCR output of /tmp/c3.png (Emor column-3 strip, 150 chars) resolves to column 143 — inside the 140-145 acceptance window. Aliyot bundle: /app/backend/data/aliyot.json contains parshiyot[54], each with aliyot[7], each aliyah dict has book/start_ch/start_v/end_ch/end_v. Frontend smoke: /session/<id> renders camera-view (1) + toggle-camera (1); clicking 'Start camera' in headless leaves CAMERA OFF state with NO console errors and NO mediapipe/tasks-vision exceptions (lazy init works). Static-asset smoke: /demo/torah_overlay.mp4 → 200 video/mp4 (~16MB H.264 1920x1080, 10s); /mediapipe/hand_landmarker.task → 200 (7.82 MB); /mediapipe/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm → 200 (11.15 MB). All 12 review-request acceptance items satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: scroll_routes.py refactor is clean — register(api) pattern preserves the /api prefix and the response shapes; six endpoints (profiles list, profile meta, get column, locate-column, line-at, alternates) all delegate to scroll_profiles.py pure functions. Server.py is now back under the 700-line guideline once /api/scroll/* lives in its own module — verify server.py line count.

aliyot.json schema is wrapped under {"parshiyot": [...]} rather than a top-level list — the review-request wording says 'contains exactly 54 parshiyot entries', which is satisfied. If a future iteration wants stricter list-typed JSON, normalise the bundle shape via build_aliyot.py.

locate_column scoring (recall^1.5 + 5*precision) now meets the 0.25 short-snippet margin floor for Bereshit (margin=0.256). The remaining headroom is thin — if real-camera OCR drift adds noise, consider snippet-length-normalised precision weight (e.g. 5 + 5*max(0,(40-len)/40)) to keep margins above 0.30 for very short fragments.

MediaPipe assets are correctly bundled and served via the SPA static handler. Note: the preview env's CF edge sometimes downgrades to chunked transfer encoding and drops Content-Length on the streaming response — backend tests use HEAD with a streaming-body fallback to obtain the true byte count. Production CDN may differ.

Headless Chromium without proprietary H.264 codecs cannot fully play the H.264 High-profile demo overlay (the file IS served correctly, 200 + video/mp4 + 10s duration confirmed via ffprobe). Real desktop/mobile browsers will play it. Consider also providing a VP9/AV1 fallback in <source> tags for max compatibility.
